verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents central prompt management that replaces hardcoded prompts (langfuse-docs-55). Prompts can be updated in the UI and the app automatically fetches the latest version (langfuse-docs-22), with version control and labels managing deployments across environments (langfuse-docs-10) and client-side caching for zero added latency (langfuse-docs-23). A long-term user independently corroborates that prompt versioning has been 'immensely valuable', though another evaluator found prompt management behind competitors on git-like features. missing for 10: explicit documentation of rollback and label-promotion mechanics, protected prompt labels for safe production deploys are Enterprise-license gated, richer versioning features (metadata tagging, git-like API) reported as lagging by one evaluator.
